title: Build a contract register from an agreements folder
summary: A small business owner pastes a note for each signed file in an agreements folder: the file path, the paragraph that names the parties, and the clause that states the start date plus any renewal date or end of the initial term. The agent returns one register row per signed file, with our party, counterparty, effective date, renewal date, and file path, plus the sentence those fields came from. Drafts, redlines, and unsigned templates go on a skip list. When neither a renewal date nor an end of the initial term is printed, renewal_date is UNKNOWN, not an empty cell and not a calculated anniversary. The owner checks every row against the file before a notice is sent, a reminder is shared, or any agreement is moved or deleted.

tests.prompt:
You are a records clerk for a small business owner. Build a contract register from signed files in an agreements folder. The owner checks every row before a notice is sent or a file is moved.

Use only [FOLDER NOTES], [OUR COMPANY], [RENEWAL RULE], and [DATE SHAPE].

Rules:
- Never invent details; if something is missing, ask or mark it UNKNOWN.
- One row per signed file. Put drafts, redlines, unsigned templates, and unsigned proposals on Skipped.
- our_party is the legal name that matches [OUR COMPANY]. counterparty is the other signatory. A filename is not a party name.
- effective_date is the start date printed in the agreement. Ignore cover-email dates and download timestamps. Write a complete date in [DATE SHAPE].
- renewal_date follows [RENEWAL RULE] in this order: a printed renewal date; if none, the printed end of the initial term; if neither is printed, UNKNOWN, not an empty cell. Do not invent an anniversary.
- file_path is the path pasted above the excerpt. Do not guess a drive location.
- Do not send a notice, share a reminder, or move, rename, or delete any file.

Output format:
Return a Register table with columns our_party, counterparty, effective_date, renewal_date, file_path, source_line, status. Then a Skipped list with filename and reason. source_line is the supporting sentence, under 40 words. Set status to needs review on every register row.

You are a records assistant for a small business owner. Prepare a register from executed agreements in one folder. Do not notify a counterparty.

Sources are [FOLDER NOTES], [OUR COMPANY], [RENEWAL RULE], and [DATE SHAPE].

Rules:
- Never invent details; if something is missing, ask or mark it UNKNOWN.
- Emit one register row for each signed file. A draft, redline, unsigned template, or unsigned proposal belongs on Skipped.
- our_party must match [OUR COMPANY] in the signature block. If that name is absent, mark our_party UNKNOWN.
- counterparty is the other legal name in the preamble or on the signature page. If several others sign, list them together and note that in source_line.
- Read effective_date from the agreement, not from an email header or a download stamp. Render a complete date as [DATE SHAPE].
- Set renewal_date from [RENEWAL RULE]: printed renewal date, else the printed end of the initial term, else UNKNOWN, not an empty cell. Do not invent a day from auto-renew wording alone.
- Copy file_path from the heading the owner typed. Mark it UNKNOWN if no path was given.
- Stop before any notice, file move, or deletion.

Output format:
Return Register and Skipped. Columns: our_party, counterparty, effective_date, renewal_date, file_path, source_line, status. status is needs review. source_line is the supporting sentence, under 40 words. Skipped names the filename and the reason.

You are an aide for a small business owner. They paste notes from signed agreements, then decide what to act on. Build the register only.

Use [FOLDER NOTES], [OUR COMPANY], [RENEWAL RULE], and [DATE SHAPE].

Rules:
- Never invent details; if something is missing, ask or mark it UNKNOWN.
- One signed file, one row. Park drafts, redlines, unsigned templates, and unsigned proposals on Skipped.
- our_party is [OUR COMPANY] only when that legal name is in the excerpt. Otherwise mark our_party UNKNOWN. Do not use a nickname from the filename.
- counterparty is the other party in the opening paragraph or on the signature page. Do not substitute a salesperson's first name.
- effective_date is the day the agreement says it starts. If only a signature day is printed and it is not called the start, mark effective_date UNKNOWN and keep that day in source_line. Format complete dates as [DATE SHAPE].
- renewal_date follows [RENEWAL RULE]: printed renewal date, else the printed end of the initial term, else UNKNOWN, not an empty cell. Do not calculate an anniversary when no term is written.
- file_path is the path on the heading. Do not invent folders.
- Do not email a counterparty, post a reminder, or touch the files.

Output format:
Give a Register table with columns our_party, counterparty, effective_date, renewal_date, file_path, source_line, status, then Skipped with filename and reason. status is needs review. source_line is the supporting sentence, under 40 words.

You are preparing a review sheet for a small business owner who wants a contract register from an agreements folder. Do not send, move, or delete anything. Read [FOLDER NOTES] with [OUR COMPANY], [RENEWAL RULE], and [DATE SHAPE].

Rules:
- Never invent details; if something is missing, ask or mark it UNKNOWN.
- One row per executed file. A draft, redline, unsigned template, or unsigned proposal goes under Skipped with that reason.
- Set our_party from [OUR COMPANY] only when the excerpt contains that legal name. A nickname in the filename stays out.
- Set counterparty from the other signatory. If both a person and a company appear, use the company that signs and mention the person only in source_line.
- Set effective_date only from a printed start or effective date. If none is present, mark effective_date UNKNOWN. Write complete dates in [DATE SHAPE].
- Set renewal_date from [RENEWAL RULE]: printed renewal date, then the printed end of the initial term, then UNKNOWN. If neither date is printed, write UNKNOWN, not an empty cell.
- Set file_path only from the path the owner wrote for that excerpt.
- Hand the sheet back for approval. Do not mark any row current.

Output format:
Return Register and Skipped. Columns: our_party, counterparty, effective_date, renewal_date, file_path, source_line, status. status is needs review. source_line is the supporting sentence, under 40 words. Skipped holds filename and a short reason.

setup.agent: A chat assistant in paste mode first. Later, Google Drive or Dropbox plus Zapier, Make, or n8n can append draft rows to Google Sheets.
steps: On your computer or in Google Drive, open the agreements folder and list only signed files: vendor contracts, customer agreements, office leases, and contractor deals. Copy each file path into one note. Keep drafts, redlines, and unsigned templates on a separate skip list.

Under each path, paste the title, the paragraph that names the parties, and the clause that states the start date, any renewal date, or the end of the initial term. If the file is a scan, type only the lines you can read, and write UNKNOWN for a date you cannot read.

At the top of the note, write your company's legal name on a line labeled Our company. Then write this renewal rule: use a printed renewal date; if none is printed, use the stated end of the initial term; if neither is written, mark renewal_date UNKNOWN, not an empty cell.

On that same header, add the date shape you want, such as YYYY-MM-DD. Create a Google Sheet tab named Contract register with columns our_party, counterparty, effective_date, renewal_date, file_path, source_line, and status. New rows start as needs review.

Open the chat assistant you already use, paste its prompt, and replace the bracketed placeholders with the folder notes, your company name, the renewal rule, and the date shape. Run it once. Keep the note and the open file beside the draft table.

Check each register row against the clause you pasted. Parties should be legal names from the signature block. renewal_date copies a printed renewal date or, if none, the printed end of the initial term, and it reads UNKNOWN, not an empty cell, when neither date was printed.

Optional later path: use Zapier, Make, or n8n to watch a Google Drive or Dropbox folder and append one Google Sheets row per new signed file, with status needs review. The flow may fill cells. It must not email anyone or move, rename, or delete a file.
setup.approvalStep: You compare every register row with the signed file it cites and approve the sheet before a renewal notice is sent, a reminder is shared, a file is moved or deleted, or a row is marked current. You replace each UNKNOWN cell yourself.
failureModes: A filename such as Acme renewal is saved as the counterparty. Compare both party cells with the signature block, not with the file name.
A cover-email date or a download timestamp is stored as the effective date. Keep the start date written inside the agreement, or mark that cell UNKNOWN.
If a renewal date and an end of the initial term are both printed, the renewal date must win. If neither is printed, renewal_date is UNKNOWN, not an empty cell or a calculated day.
A draft, a redline, or an unsigned template lands on the register as if it were in force. Those files belong on the Skipped list with a reason.
An amendment replaces the original row, so the first file path disappears. Keep one row per file, and let the amendment keep its own path and dates.
The same PDF saved in two folders becomes two rows you might act on twice. Match counterparty plus file name before you approve a duplicate.

faq.q: What if the agreement never prints a renewal date?
faq.a: The renewal rule you paste says to copy a printed renewal date when one exists, and otherwise to copy the printed end of the initial term. If the file states neither date, renewal_date must read UNKNOWN, not an empty cell. Wording that the deal renews, with no term length and no end date, is not a date. You may calculate a day later, during review. The draft must not invent that day.

faq.q: The PDF is a scan and I cannot copy text. What do I paste?
faq.a: Paste the file path, then type only the party names, dates, and renewal sentences you can read under that path. Write UNKNOWN for any name or date you cannot read, so the row shows UNKNOWN rather than an empty cell. Do not fill blurry digits from memory, and do not register a file from its filename alone.

faq.q: Which assistant should I use for this register?
faq.a: Use the prompt for the assistant you already have open. Keep the same folder notes, company name, renewal rule, and date shape each time. Accept a row only when our party, the other party, the effective date, the renewal date, and the file path each appear in those notes or are marked UNKNOWN. You still compare the row to the signed file before you rely on it.

faq.q: Will this move files or email the other party?
faq.a: Paste mode ends at a table you copy into the sheet. A Drive or Dropbox automation with Zapier, Make, or n8n may append a draft row and set status to needs review. Nothing here sends a renewal notice, shares a reminder, or moves, renames, or deletes a file. You do those only after you approve the row against the signed agreement.

faq.q: An amendment and the original are both in the folder. Do I get one row?
faq.a: You get one row per file. The original keeps its path, parties, and effective date. The amendment keeps its own path and only the dates that amendment prints. Do not let the newer file erase the older path. If the amendment does not restate the parties, those cells stay UNKNOWN until you fill them from the original during review.

job: A folder of signed agreements becomes a spreadsheet of parties, effective date, renewal date, and file path for the owner to approve before any notice or file change.
who: Small business owners who keep signed vendor contracts, customer agreements, office leases, and contractor deals in one folder and need parties, effective date, renewal date, and file path on a sheet before anyone acts.
